messages:
alice-eng: Heads up — deploy-bot just flagged embeddings rollout (embeddings:v3.4.8) during the late change window (23:45 UTC). p95 latency +15%, error-rate ~2.3%. deploy-bot suggests fallback. Should we allow autopilot revert or do a manual rollback? cc @dave-oncall @ben-sre

deploy-bot: AUTOPILOT_SUGGEST -> rollback to embeddings:v3.4.7. Triggers: p95>180ms for 5m, error_rate>2% for 3m. Canary slice=8%. Actionable options: AUTO_REVERT or HOLD_FOR_HUMAN.

ben-sre: can we get the breakdown by region and slice? is this confined to the canary or leaking to 20% traffic?

ops-bot: telemetry snapshot: region=us-west-2 (80% of canary traffic), p95_usw2=210ms, p95_eu=172ms, overall error_rate=2.3%. No KV cache evictions reported.

carol-prod: Dedicated customers on this route — if we rollback we need to pin their pool to v3.4.7 to avoid flapping. Also needs a short blurb in release notes.

dave-oncall: I'm taking the handoff. It's within our late window; autopilot may revert but that can cause a noisy change. recommend manual rollback + short-maint note. Ben, can you execute? I'll coordinate comms.

ben-sre: I can run the manual rollback. Plan: 1) Pause rollout traffic slice, 2) pin service manifest to embeddings:v3.4.7, 3) run /runbook rollback-embeddings, 4) monitor 10m. Shout if rollback fails.

alice-eng: Agreed. Also enable suppress-autopilot on this release so deploy-bot doesn't flip it back. small steps: 
```
# pause slice
deployctl traffic pause --release embeddings:v3.4.8 --slice canary
# pin
deployctl release pin --service embeddings --version v3.4.7 --reason "rollback: latency/error spike"
# runbook
/runbook rollback-embeddings
```

ops-bot: runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/ops/runbooks/rollback-embeddings. Also posting checklist: [confirm pin updated] [notify-customer-channel] [update-release-notes-draft].

eve-pm: I'll draft a short customer-facing note: one sentence + ETA for stability. Put draft in #customer-comms for review.

carol-prod: If we pin, also set the dedicated pools to maintain v3.4.7 until EOD. I'll send a note to the Dedicated account owners.

ben-sre: executing now: pausing slice -> done. pin command -> issued. suppress-autopilot -> set. Starting rollback job (job-id: rb-49321).

deploy-bot: ACTION_LOG: manual-rollback-triggered by ben-sre. Previous autopilot suppressed by user flag. 

ben-sre: rollback job reports all replicas back on v3.4.7, health checks passing. P95_usw2 down to 160ms after 3m, error_rate 0.5%. Monitoring 10m.

dave-oncall: Good. I'll post an internal postmortem thread with initial hypotheses. Alice, please update release notes and mark the release as rolled back.

alice-eng: Updated release notes: added "rolled back embeddings v3.4.8 due to latency + error spike; reverted to v3.4.7; investigating." Also updated the release metadata with pin.

eve-pm: Customer note draft posted in #customer-comms. Short, transparent. Ready for send when ops gives all-clear.

ben-sre: 10m monitor complete. stability looks restored across regions. Closing rollback job rb-49321.

ad: (automated) incident-bot: Created incident INC-2024-49321 for follow-up, assigned to eng-ml and eng-runtime to investigate cause.

alice-eng: Thanks all. Action items: eng-ml to root cause, eng-runtime to test kernel/quantization interactions, carol to notify dedicated customers, eve to send customer note once RC confirms. I'll lock the release window for 24h. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
